QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: selectedMicrophone
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Selected audio input device for voice commands.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Selected audio input device for voice commands.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Microphone

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: noiseFilterEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Enable or disable real-time noise suppression.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Filters background environmental noise (wind, propeller buzz) from incoming microphone audio.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Noise Suppression

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: noiseFilterLevel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Controls the aggressiveness of background noise filtering on incoming microphone audio.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Suppression Level

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: maxRecordingDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum recording duration for voice commands before automatic stop.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Limits voice command recording duration to prevent runaway audio capture. Automatically stops recording when reached.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Max Recording Duration

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: pushToTalkKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Keyboard shortcut key for Push-to-Talk voice commanding.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Physical keyboard key held down to record voice commands.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: PTT Shortcut Key

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sttLanguage
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Speech recognition language for voice commands.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Selects the spoken language used by the offline Speech-to-Text engine.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Speech Language

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sttSelectedModel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Name or identifier of the selected Speech-to-Text model discovered in the model directory. The compatible runtime engine is resolved automatically.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Speech Model

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sttIdleUnloadTimeout
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Idle duration before unloading the STT model from memory.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Automatically releases STT model memory when voice control is inactive. Set to Always Keep Loaded to prevent unloading.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Always Keep Loaded,1 min,3 min,5 min,10 min
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Model Memory Timeout

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sttUseGpu
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Enable GPU acceleration for speech recognition if available.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Uses GPU hardware acceleration for STT inference when supported, automatically falling back to CPU if unavailable.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: GPU Acceleration
